extension_candidates.authority: PRD and Runtime remain authoritative; candidate is not a requirement until adopted

acceptance: Following a focusboard://task link from a reminder email lands a signed-in user on that task's context after an auth check, and lands an anonymous user on sign-in with a recoverable onward path.
candidate.cost: Small increment on top of this loop's scheme handler: one authenticated-safe link form, a route that opens the task context after sign-in checks.
candidate.product_value: A reminder link that opens the exact task turns email into a one-click return to the next useful action, which is the product promise in PRD section 2.
candidate.rationale: PRD section 7 requires reminder emails to carry a safe link; once the focusboard:// scheme is registered for auth, the same mechanism can anchor reminder links to a specific task view, deepening the primary loop's capture-to-work flow.
candidate.risk: Authenticated-safe link design must avoid leaking task data to unauthenticated recipients; single-instance routing and cold-start handling need care.

extension_summary.authority: only active_ids may enter the current Developer objective

implied_completion: Following the link while the app is already running lands on the verify continuation instead of dead-ending outside the product.
An expired or already-consumed link token produces the recoverable error state with a clear next action.
After link-based verification the user is routed onward to sign in with their entered email preserved.
mandatory_objectives: The focusboard:// verification link is registered at the OS level and reaches the running or launching application.
Verify-by-link consumes the single-use token exactly once and the paste-the-link fallback keeps working.
The PRD section 3 golden path through step 5 is drivable live so prd_golden_path can be re-verified against the new candidate hash.
Preserved baselines stay passing: tauri_source_manifest, the native launch chain, white-box persistence tests, and the least-privilege security posture.
task_specification.objective: Make the PRD section 3 first-run golden path true in the product: register focusboard:// at the OS level so a verification email link followed by the user reaches Focusboard and its single-use token is consumed through the existing verify-continuation flow, with the paste-the-link fallback preserved, so the frozen prd_golden_path review can pass on live register-verify-signin-quickadd-restart evidence while the preserved baselines (tauri_source_manifest, native launch chain, white-box persistence tests, security posture) stay green.

diagnosis.root_cause: Verification emails contain focusboard://auth links (VERIFY_BASE in src-tauri/src/lib.rs), but the candidate never registers the focusboard:// scheme with the OS: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json has no deep-link scheme configuration, src-tauri/Cargo.toml declares no deep-link plugin, and no OS open-URL event handler exists in the app entry. Following the emailed link therefore dead-ends outside the application, and verification completes only through the paste-the-link fallback in VerifyEmailView (src/auth/AuthViews.tsx). PRD section 3 step 3 ('follow the link, and return to the application') is thus unmet by the product itself, which is the product-failure root behind the unverified prd_golden_path check.

stop_conditions: The desktop environment under the native runtime cannot deliver focusboard:// launches to the application even after correct registration; report blocked with the concrete launch-receipt failure.
Adding scheme handling regresses the preserved native launch chain, white-box persistence tests, or security posture and cannot be repaired within the loop budget.
The frozen PRD, quality contract, or candidate paths become unavailable to the Developer role.

strategy.rationale: The host pinned find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered as the highest-priority actionable product failure, and gap:prd_golden_path is the required unverified check; both describe one surface. Registering the focusboard:// scheme is the root-cause repair that simultaneously makes the PRD section 3 first-run path livable end to end, letting this single-task loop convert the evidence gap into real native replay receipts without expanding scope into deferred cosmetic or style debt.

code: cargo test on the pinned 1.90.0 toolchain passes with the scheme handler added, including the single-use token and paste-fallback coverage.
tauri_source_manifest stays green: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json remains present and valid after the deep-link configuration change, and a fresh npm install plus cargo build exits 0.
runtime: focusboard-native-webdriver replay drives register, follow a focusboard://auth link at the OS level, verify, sign in, quick-add, and restart, emitting a passing runtime_state receipt bound to the new candidate hash and engine id tauri.
A replay of the already-consumed link token shows the recoverable expired-or-consumed state, and the paste-fallback variant still completes verification.
visual: Live capture of the verify-continuation and signed-in shell after scheme launch matches the preserved auth-shell direction from PRD 9.1 with no prohibited visual patterns.

done_when: A focusboard://auth verification link followed at the OS level launches or foregrounds Focusboard and lands on the verify-continuation surface with the token consumed exactly once.
Verification via followed link reaches the same signed-in-capable state as the paste fallback, and the paste fallback still passes.
Replaying the same link token after consumption shows the existing recoverable expired-or-consumed error state rather than silent success.
The register, verify-by-link, sign in, quick-add, restart persistence sequence is completable end to end through the live UI and IPC per PRD section 3 steps 1 through 5.
Fresh npm install plus cargo build exits 0 and the white-box cargo test suite passes with the scheme handler added.
tasks.instructions: Repair the pinned product failure at its root: make the focusboard:// verification link actually deliver into the application. Register the scheme in the Tauri desktop configuration and handle the OS open-URL path in the Rust entry so the link payload (auth token) reaches the existing verify-continuation surface in VerifyEmailView, consuming the single-use token exactly once. Keep the paste-the-link fallback working unchanged for environments where scheme delivery is unavailable. Do not weaken CSP, capabilities, or the server-side require_user gates, and do not alter the preserved auth-shell visual direction. Self-validate locally: fresh npm install plus cargo build exits 0, the white-box cargo test suite passes, and a semantic-DOM driver can complete register, follow a focusboard://auth link, verify, sign in, quick-add, and restart with persisted state. Leave native replay recapture, visual bundles, and issue disposition to Runtime and Tester.

risk_note.summary: OS-level scheme delivery depends on desktop-environment integration that a dev-mode native runtime may not fully exercise, so follow-the-link evidence could return insufficient even with correct registration.
risk_note.validation: Most likely to end insufficient_evidence: the focusboard-native-webdriver follow-the-link replay. Mitigate by also capturing in-app open-URL handling while the app is already running, and keep the paste-fallback variant measurable so verification evidence survives a cold-start limitation.
risk_note.why_now: The issue is host-pinned this loop, and PRD section 3 step 3 is the only golden-path step blocked by a product defect rather than by evidence capture.
